title: Link between Heat-not-burn Tobacco Products and Risk to Health
what_it_is: Link between Heat-not-burn Tobacco Products and Risk to Health

sections.label: Heat-not-burn tobacco product risks
sections.summary: Evidence suggests heat-not-burn products are not significantly different from traditional cigarettes in risk, and HSA found comparable nicotine content.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Existing evidence suggests that heat-not-burn tobacco products are not significantly different from traditional cigarettes in terms of risk to both smokers and non-smokers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: HSA has also done preliminary tests on such products and found that the nicotine content is comparable to traditional cigarettes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: While there have been claims that such tobacco products are less harmful than traditional cigarettes, these claims are made by the tobacco industry and, to date, there is very little independent evidence supporting such claims.

sections.label: No safe tobacco level
sections.summary: There is no documented evidence of any safe level of tobacco use, and lower risk tobacco products remain harmful due to cancer-causing chemicals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: First, let me say that there is no documented evidence of any safe level of tobacco use.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The fact is that such so-called lower risk tobacco products are still harmful because it exposes the users to cancer-causing chemicals.

sections.label: Youth gateway to nicotine addiction
sections.summary: Allowing such products could attract more users, especially youths, risking nicotine addiction and smoking, so a precautionary public health approach is adopted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Our concern really is with the fact that allowing the use of such products could attract a much larger group of users, especially among the youths, and that could be the gateway to nicotine addiction and, eventually, smoking.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The US CDC has reported that e-cigarette use among high school students between 2011 and 2015 increased by more than 10 times, from 1.5% to 16%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we are doing is to adopt and aim for a very high and precautionary level of public health protection against known as well as potential harms of emerging tobacco products, including heat-not-burn tobacco products.
